# Digitize'NStitch

> Online embroidery digitizing and vector art studio. We convert logos and artwork into machine-ready embroidery files and clean vector art, delivered by email. Serving clients in the USA, UK, Canada, Australia and worldwide.

## Services
- [Embroidery Digitizing](https://digitizenstitch.com/embroidery-digitizing): logos and artwork converted into stitch files. Formats: DST, PES, EMB, EXP, JEF, VP3, XXX, HUS, PEC and others on request.
- [Vector Art](https://digitizenstitch.com/vector-art): raster to vector conversion, starting at $9.99. Formats: AI, EPS, PDF, SVG, PNG.
- [Custom Patches](https://digitizenstitch.com/patches): physical patches, priced on quote.

## Embroidery digitizing prices
- Under 5 inches (sleeve, cap logo, left chest, 4x4 and 5x5 hoop): $4.99–$9.99, 12–24 hours.
- 5–7 inches (mid chest, hoodie chest, tote bags, 5x7 hoop): $9.99–$14.99, 12–24 hours.
- Over 7 inches (full front, jacket back, large appliqué, 6x10 and 8x12 hoops): on quote, 24–48 hours.
- Free edits and revisions. Payment by PayPal only. Files delivered by email.

## How to order
Submit the [quote form](https://digitizenstitch.com/quote). Our team confirms the order and PayPal payment by email, then delivers the files by email.
